newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni advertises for bidders for zinc unit.
newsitem.headline: Eni advertises for bidders for zinc unit.

text.p: Italian energy group Eni said on Wednesday it was re-advertising for bidders for its Pertusola Sud zinc producing unit at Crotone.
It said in a statement advertisements would be placed in the national and international press.
An initial invitation to bid was made in April.

Earlier this month Osmium Holdings, a group of British and U.S. investors, said it had run into problems in its plans to buy the 100,000 tonnes a year Crotone zinc smelter and convert it into a nickel-copper refinery.
That was because Russia's Norilsk Nickel had insisted on reviewing an agreement to supply concentrates, it said.
As a result, Osmium was forced to tell Eni that it would not be able to meet an end-July deadline to buy the facility.
